notes: 1x4 HDMI distribution amplifier (18Gbps / HDMI 2.0a, HDCP 2.2, up to 4K60 4:4:4). Manufacturer AVPro Edge's product site (avproedge.com) now redirects to avproglobal.com, which was used as the primary source; cross-checked against AV-iQ.com and Markertek.com, which agree on power specs and dimensions. The 5V DC input uses AVPro's proprietary locking connector (included external power supply, AC 100-240V in, DC 5V/2A out, 4W max) — mapped to "dc-barrel" as the closest listed option, but note it locks and is not a generic barrel jack. The firmware/service port is labeled Mini-USB on the unit; since "usb-micro" (Micro-USB) is the nearest option in the allowed connector list, it was used instead of the exact Mini-USB type. Ultra-low-profile desktop/shelf unit (0.66" x 3.375" x 5.69") with included mounting ears — not a standard 19" rack-width unit, so rackUnits is omitted.

ports.name: Firmware
ports.note: Labeled as a Mini-USB service/firmware-update port on the unit; Mini-USB is not in the allowed connector list so the closest match, Micro-USB, was used.

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: Proprietary locking 5V DC connector (external AC-to-DC power supply included), not a plain barrel jack.
